name: -10 AN Straight Female Push-Loc Fitting
title: -10 AN Straight Female Push-Loc Fitting
description:
The -10 AN Straight Female Push-Loc Fitting is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with their proprietary polish and anodizing process.

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, Push-Loc AN Fittings are designed specifically for use with high-quality Push-Loc hose, and to accept a male AN Flare Fitting.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
